rationale: Netflix markets this consistently as a subscription 'service' for streaming access rather than a purchase, and explicitly discloses that only a limited, non-transferable license is granted with no title transferred, so there is little bait-and-switch on ownership. It loses points for length, dense numbered legalese, a no-refunds policy, broad suspension/termination rights, and a remote-access support clause, though notice periods for price/terms changes are reasonably generous (30 days).
evidence_quotes: we grant you a limited, non-exclusive, non-transferable right to access the Netflix service and view Netflix content. Except for the foregoing, no right, title or interest shall be transferred to you
Payments are non-refundable and we do not provide refunds or credits for any partial-month membership periods or unwatched Netflix content
We may terminate or restrict your use of our service if you violate these Terms of Use or are engaged in illegal or fraudulent use of the service
